items.title: Live: Swans looking for top gear against Saints ahead of Sunday night football
items.description: The Sydney Swans look to stay in touch with Fremantle as they host St Kilda at the SCG, ahead of a Sunday night clash between Essendon and Carlton. Follow live.

items.title: Live: 'Jarome has to stand up': Tigers torn apart, Blues star limps off field
items.description: NRL premiership winning halves Nathan Cleary and Jarome Luai stand on opposite sides as Wests Tigers host the Penrith Panthers in Western Sydney. Follow live.

items.title: Inside a Trump-linked plan to turn a communist-era miliary base into a luxe resort
items.description: Ivanka Trump has floated "manifestations" of luxury holidays. Meanwhile, Albanians are claiming "irreversible" ecological damage. Why protests are shaking Albania.

items.title: 'Almost dying wasn't on my bingo card': Biles reveals 'scariest' health scare
items.description: Decorated gymnast Simone Biles shares an undisclosed health scare, telling her social media followers that "almost dying wasn't on my bingo card earlier this week".

items.title: 'Happening in every university': Students sent to Putin's 'meat grinder'
items.description: Lessons look a little different at some universities and technical colleges around Russia this year, as the Kremlin tries to entice students to enlist in the military to cover massive casualties in Ukraine.

items.title: Mourners farewell gangster a day after gunman targets wrong funeral venue
items.description: Dozens of mourners have turned out to farewell Sydney crime boss Lorenzo Lemalu at a funeral held at Lakemba Mosque, in Sydney's western suburbs.

items.title: 'Beyond our capacity' to defend sea trade lanes, Shoebridge says
items.description: Greens defence spokesman David Shoebridge says it is "ridiculous" to think Australia's military could defend the nation's global trade lanes, and acquiring nuclear-powered submarines under AUKUS only invites Australia to a conflict between the United States and China.

items.title: Live: Australian composer cracks ABC Classic 100 top 35, but who will be #1?
items.description: Tens of thousands of Australians have cast their votes in the 2025 Classic 100: Greatest Of All Time. Join us as we count down to number one.

items.title: Missing Melbourne teacher allegedly murdered by brother in India
items.description: Indian authorities allege Melbourne maths teacher Sunil Sharma was murdered by his brother and dumped in a canal. He had been in India to prepare a property for sale.

items.title: Trump battles historians for ownership of US presidential records
items.description: The Trump administration is pushing for a return to pre-Nixon days when US presidents could do whatever they wanted with presidential records.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
